calculation.expression: when lagged cross-asset downside breadth >= trailing 120-day 70th percentile: -(close_t/close_{t-3}-1), cross-sectionally median demeaned; otherwise missing
calculation.description: During unusually broad three-day weakness across the 15 tradable benchmark instruments, rank assets by three-day reversal signal. The breadth condition and all price inputs are lagged/completed-data based.

validation.regime_notes: Positive daily and multi-day IC across the full 2020-2026 synthetic sample; signal is conditional and therefore has 33.99% pointwise coverage. Small 15-instrument cross-sections imply conservative interpretation.
